# Stationary-source and common-action benchmark calculations

These calculations belong to [Theorems I.13t and I.13w](../../../appendices/appendix_i_scaled_gravity.md). The owning theorems supply the source equations, unique normalization, finite physical domains, optical paths, error bounds and complete proofs. All finite decimal endpoints below are exact rational numbers in SI units unless a dimensionless ratio is indicated. The constants define nominal mathematical preparations.

<a id="stationary-benchmarks"></a>
